   - Chlorophyll (karshe na shuka) **kuzace haske biyu** (blue da red) don **fotons** (light energy) da ke iya haɗa photosynthesis.

   - **Shuka A (green filter):**  
     - Green filter **reflects green light**, kuma **blocks blue/ red photons**.  
     - Shuka A **ba iya kuzace haske ba** don photosynthesis, kuma **girman su ba iya haɗa ba**.  
   - **Shuka B (blue filter):**  
     - Blue filter **allows blue photons** (absorbed by chlorophyll) **to pass through**.  
     - Shuka B **kuzace haske blue**, kuma **girman su sosai** domin photosynthesis.  

3. **Kowace Amsoshin:**  
   - **Option B** ce **sawara** saboda shuka B **kuzace haske blue** (absorbed by chlorophyll), kuma **girman su sosai**.

**Tsayar daidai:**  
A cikin kwayar Endokrin, **tsarin martani na kwayoyin halitta** (kamar HPA axis) ya zama dole ɗalibanka domin su iya bambance yadda homonai ke fara martani a cikin kwayar halitta mai karɓa. Lokacin da kwayar halitta yana da karɓa (kamar stress), **hypothalamus** ya fara **corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH)**, kuma ya iya **pituitary** don fara **adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH)**. ACTH ya iya **adrenal glands** don fara **cortisol**, mai karɓa a cikin kwayar stress. Tsarin wanda ke fara **negative feedback** (kamar cortisol ya iya hypothalamus da pituitary don hausa martani) ya zama ƙungiyoyin da za a iya tantance martani. 

**Munyari:**  
- **A (Abubuwan Fitar da Hormone):** Tsarin fitar da fitar da homonai (kamar negative feedback) ya tantance martani, lekun yake kuma ƙungiyoyin da za a iya tantance, lekun **bukar dole ɗalibanka** yana da karɓa.  
- **B (Siffar sinadarin Hormones):** Siffar sinadarin homonai yana da ƙungiyoyin, lekun yake kuma ƙungiyoyin da za a iya tantance martani.  
- **C (Daidaita hormons a sanadin ruwan jiki):** Daidaita homonai a ruwan jiki yana da ƙungiyoyin, lekun yake kuma ƙungiyoyin da za a iya tantance martani.  
- **D (Tsarin martani na kwayoyin halitta):** Tsarin wanda ke fara **hypothalamus → pituitary → adrenal glands** (HPA axis) ya zama **dole ɗalibanka** domin su iya bambance yadda homonai ke fara martani a cikin kwayar stress.  

**Kafin:** Tsarin martani na kwayoyin halitta (D) ya tantance **bukar dole ɗalibanka** domin su iya bambance yadda homonai ke fara martani a cikin kwayar stress.

**Tallaci:**  
Wanne kuma aiki na bincike, **abubuwan canzawa (variables)** yana nuna wasan abubuwan da ke haɓaka daga cikin aiki don kowannan yawa. Don **gano abubuwan canzawa**, malami ya kalla **tsare-tsaren sakamako** (manipulate conditions) don kowannan yawa. Wanne kuma, **abubuwan canzawa** yana kuma daga cikin:  
- **Abubuwan guba (independent variable):** Abubuwan malami ya kalla daga cikin aiki.  
- **Abubuwan ganyen (dependent variable):** Abubuwan yana haɓaka daga abubuwan guba.  

**Option B** yana nuna cewa malami ya kalla **tsare-tsaren sakamako** (manipulate conditions) don kowannan yawa, kuma su **shirya abubuwan** (observe variables) don kowannan yawa. Wanne kuma, wannan yana samun **hanyoyin bincike** (scientific method), kuma yana samun **gano abubuwan canzawa**.  

**Munyari:**  
- **Option A** (Gine-ginen matatar sigari) yana samun **ƙidaya** (reliability) kuma **Option D** (saukowa) yana samun **ƙidaya** (control group), kuma **Option C** (tsarin nazari) yana samun **nazari** (theory), kuma **Option B** yana samun **hanyoyin bincike** (experimental design).  

**Kuma, B yana samun aiki na ƙungiyoyi don gano abubuwan canzawa.**

- **Friedrich Miescher** (1869) ya kawo DNA a matsayin "nuclein" tare da amfani da ƙungiyoyin ƙarfi.  
- **Robert Feulgen** (1924) ya kawo **Feulgen reaction**, yana nuna DNA a cikin ƙarfi.  
- **P.A. Levene** (1930s) ya kawo **nucleotide** (nukleotidu) a matsayin DNA, kuma ya kawo **tetranucleotide hypothesis** (wala yana da ƙungiyoyin 4 nukleotidu), kuma ya kawo DNA a matsayin "molecule too simple to carry genetic information."  
- **Frederick Griffith** (1928) ya kawo **bacterial transformation**, yana nuna "transforming principle" (DNA) yana ƙidaya rayuwa.  
- **Oswald Avery, Colin MacLeod, da Maclyn McCarty** (1944) ya kawo DNA yana ƙidaya rayuwa tare da amfani da **Griffith's experiment**.  
- **Alfred Hershey da Martha Chase** (1952) ya kawo DNA yana ƙidaya rayuwa tare da amfani da **phage experiment** (radioactive labeling).  

**Option D** yana nuna **DNA yana ƙidaya rayuwa**, kamar kungiyoyin **Griffith, Avery, Hershey, da Chase**, kuma **Miescher da Feulgen** yana nuna DNA a matsayin ƙarfi. **Levene's tetranucleotide hypothesis** yana ƙidaya **option A**, kamar kungiyoyin **structure**, kuma **option B da C** yana nuna **central dogma** (gene → protein) da **replication/transcription**, kamar kungiyoyin **Watson, Crick, da Franklin**. 

**Saya da:** D. Fassara gwaje-gwaje da ke nuna DNA a matsayin kwayar halittar da ke ɗauke da bayanan asali na rayuwa.

**Tallaci:** 

A cikin ƙungiyoyi na kimiyya, **tsarin amsa iri ɗaya** (kinetic theory of matter) ya nuna cewa:

1. **Abubuwan halitta** (particles) **yana da haɗin da suka ƙunshe a matsayin ƙarfi** (random motion).
2. **Haɗin su yana da daban-daban** (space between them).
3. **Haɗin su yana kalla da su kuma da gidi** (collide with each other and container walls).
4. **Sanyi** (temperature) **yana da ƙungiyar kasancewar haɗin su** (average kinetic energy of particles).

**Tallaci da Amsa C:**

- **Option C** ce: *"Zafi yana nufin kasancewar tsare-tsare guda biyu ko fiye."* (Heat causes the particles to move in two or three dimensions). 
- **Wanne ce ƙungiyar da ba yana dace da tsarin amsa iri ɗaya** (kinetic theory). Tsarin amsa iri ɗaya **ba yana nuna cewa zafi yana nufin kasancewar haɗin su** (cause the motion), kuma **ba yana nuna cewa zafi yana nufin haɗin su kafin guda biyu ko fiye** (cause movement in two or three dimensions). 
- **Haɗin su kafin guda biyu ko fiye** (movement in two or three dimensions) **yana da ƙungiyar matsayin halitta** (state of matter). Masu **gida** (solid) yana da haɗin **guda biyu** (vibrational), masu **lafiya** (liquid) yana da haɗin **guda biyu ko fiye** (translational and rotational), da masu **kwarewa** (gas) yana da haɗin **guda fiye** (free translational). 
- **Zafi** (heat) **yana da ƙungiyar kasancewar haɗin su**, kuma **ba yana nufin kasancewar haɗin su** (cause the motion). 

**Tallaci da Amsa D:**

- **Option D** ce: *"Zafi yana da zafin jiki a matsayin ma'aunin ma'auni na zahirinsa."* (Heat has the property of transferring in the form of visible movement). 
- **Wanne ce ƙungiyar da yana dace da tsarin amsa iri ɗaya** (kinetic theory). Tsarin amsa iri ɗaya **yana nuna cewa haɗin su yana kalla da su kuma da gidi**, kuma **zafi yana da ƙungiyar kasancewar haɗin su**. **Zafin jiki** (heat transfer) **yana da ƙungiyar haɗin su**, kuma **yana da ƙungiyar ma'auni na zahirinsa** (visible movement) **a matsayin kwarewa** (gases) **da lafiya** (liquids).

**Tallaci:**  
Aikin bincike da ke nuna haske da fitilu masu girma a cikin yanayi guda biyu (1 da 2) ke amfani da **ƙa'idoji** (chemical kinetics) don tafaddami **hanyoyin haske** da **matakan da za a iya hausa**. Kada yanayi ta amfani da **tsarin ɓararraƙi** (eksperimental setup) da **geometriyar haske** (kamar ƙungiyar allo, kafin ruwa, da kuma ƙungiyar haske) ke nuna **ƙirƙirinsu** na haske da **ƙungiyoyin** ke amfani da **ƙa'idoji** don tafaddami **matakan da za a iya hausa**.

- **Ƙa'idoji** (chemical kinetics) ke nuna **matakan da za a iya hausa** da **faktoran** ke amfani da **haske** (kamar ƙungiyar allo, kafin ruwa, da kuma ƙungiyar haske).  

**Wanne kimiyya ce?**

Tambayoyin D ya nuna amfani da **zafi na kimiyya** (specific heat) don gabatar da manufar kimiyya. A kowanne halaye, kwalbar da baƙi (metal) da ruwa a cikin su suna da zafi mafi girma. Zafi na kimiyya na ruwa (4.186 J/g°C) ya ƙidaya zafi na kimiyya na kwalbar (kamar 0.45 J/g°C). Lokacin da kwalbar ya kai zafi, suka yiwu zafi kuma suka ɗauka ruwa a cikin su. - **D:** **Ya nuna farko cikin zafi na kwalbar (metal) da ruwa**, kuma ya ƙaru amfani da **zafi na kimiyya** don samuwa a jikin su.  

**Kusan:** Tambayoyin D ya dace don gabatar da manufar kimiyya tare da amfani da farko cikin zafi na kimiyya na abubuwan da suka ɗauka.

**Bayan:**  
Wannan aikin bincike yana da wadawa daga **kwayoyin halitta** (solubility) da **narkewar abubuwa** a cikin **ruwa** (solvent polar). A lokacin da malamar suke narkar da abubuwa daban-daban a cikin ruwa, su zai nuna **tsarin da abubuwa suke narkewa** (dissolve) ko **ba**. 

- **NaCl (gishiri)** da **sugar (sukar)** da **bicarbonate** yana da **kwayoyin polar** kuma suke narkewa a cikin ruwa.  
- **Mai** (oil) yana da **kwayoyin non-polar**, kuma **ba su narkewa** a cikin ruwa.  
- **Barasa** (alcohol) yana da **kwayoyin polar** kuma suke narkewa a cikin ruwa.  

Option **C** yana nuna **mu'amalolin tsakanin kwayoyin abubuwa da kwayoyin solvent (ruwa)**, kuma yana da **danganta** (observation) don **narkewar kayan abubuwa**. Wannan yana da **ƙungiyoyin kimiyya** domin nuna **wace abubuwa suke narkewa a cikin ruwa** da **wace ba**. 

Option **A** da **B** yana da **solvent farko** (non-polar solvent), kuma **ba yana da ƙungiyoyin kimiyya** domin ruwa. Option **D** yana da **rashin daɗi**, kuma **ba yana da ƙungiyoyin kimiyya** domin **kwayoyin abubuwa**. 

**Kowanne ɗalilin kimiyya** yana nuna cewa **solubility** yana da **tsarin kwayoyin abubuwa da solvent**. Kamar **"like dissolves like"**, kuma **C** yana da **ƙungiyoyin kimiyya** domin **narkewar abubuwa daban-daban a cikin ruwa**.

A lokacin da kwayoyin halitta (plant cells) ya fallasa su ga ƙwarewa mai yawan sinadarai (hypertonic solution), **matsakaicin wajen kwayar halitta yana da yawan gishiri dacewa** (higher solute concentration) kuma **matsakaicin cikin kwayar halitta yana da yawan gishiri kasa** (lower solute concentration). Hakanan, **ruwa yana motsawa daga cikin tantanin halitta zuwa wajen tantanin halitta** tare da osmosis.  

- **Girman ruwan cikin kwayar halitta** (cytoplasm) **yana rage**, kuma **tantanin halitta yana da ƙungiyar laushi** (shrinks) **kada** (plasmolysis).  
- **Bangon tantanin halitta** (cell wall) **yana da ƙungiyar zuwa** (rigid), kuma **bokan su ba yana bincika** (burst), kuma **yana da ƙungiyar laushi** (shrinks) **kada**.  
- **Wajen tantanin halitta** (cell wall) **yana da yawan gishiri kasa** (less solute) kuma **yana motsa ruwa zuwa wajen tantanin halitta** (loses water to the external solution).  

**Option C** yana iya kiyaye ingancin kimiyya don aiki na yau, kuma yana iya amfani da yaren da malami ya dace da matakin karatun (osmosis) domin kiyaye ƙungiyar laushi na kwayoyin halitta.

- **Option A** yana iya faruwa (water moves into the cell), wanda ke ƙafin da yawa (hypotonic solution).  
- **Option B** yana iya nuna cewa wajen tantanin halitta yana da yawan gishiri dacewa (hypertonic), wanda ke ƙafin da yawa (cell wall is a structure, not a solution).  
- **Option D** yana iya nuna cewa wajen tantanin halitta yana da yawan gishiri dacewa (hypertonic), wanda ke ƙafin da yawa (cell wall is not a solution).  

**Option C** yana iya kiyaye ƙungiyar laushi na kwayoyin halitta tare da osmosis, kuma yana iya nuna cewa **tantanin halitta yana da ƙungiyar laushi kada** (plasmolysis) saboda **ruwa yana motsawa daga cikin tantanin halitta zuwa wajen tantanin halitta**.

**Amsa: C. Halayen T lymphocytes**

### **Tsayar daidai:**

A cikin rukunin Kwayoyin Halittu da Tsaikon Kariya na Jikin Dan Adam, **T lymphocytes** (wannan ya kama T cells) ce wajen **kwayoyin kariya na asali** (innate immunity) da **kwayoyin kariya na ƙaranci** (adaptive immunity). Wadanda T lymphocytes su koyi **kimiyya da alluran rigakafi** (immune response) tare da:

- **T helper cells (CD4+)** – su koyi kariya na ƙaranci don kammala **B cells** don rabawa **antibodies** da **cytotoxic T cells** don kammala wajen kariya.
- **Cytotoxic T cells (CD8+)** – su koyi kariya na ƙaranci don **kafin rigakafin** kamar **virus-infected cells** da **cancer cells**.
- **Memory T cells** – su koyi kariya na ƙaranci don **kafin rigakafin** kamar **wani virus** kada wanne koyi da wanne kuma.

**T lymphocytes** su koyi **kimiyya da alluran rigakafi** tare da amfani da **receptors** da suka ƙara **antigens** kamar **virus** da **bacteria**, kuma su koyi **kariya na ƙaranci** don kafin rigakafin. Wanne ne kamar **T cells** su koyi **kimiyya da alluran rigakafi** tare da **specificity** da **memory**, wanda ke ƙidaya **adaptive immunity**.

**Tallaci:**  
Lokacin da koyoyin titration (kimiyya) ke ci gaba, pH ya badawa dacewa a lokaci na *equivalence point* (matakin da adadin moles na acid yana da adadin moles na base). Sababuwa, kamar yadda koyoyin kimiyya yana nuna, **buffer capacity** (kamar yadda pH yana iya badawa) ya kusanta a lokaci haka. A lokaci haka, wasu moles na base mai ƙarfi (kamar NaOH) da ke ƙara ya yi wasu OH⁻ ions, wanda ya badawa pH dacewa. 

**Option C** yana nuna cewa **adadin moles na excess** (base mai ƙarfi) ya iya nuna kamar yadda pH yana badawa dacewa. Kamar halbe, kada drop na base mai ƙarfi da ke ƙara a lokaci na equivalence point ya yi wasu OH⁻ ions, wanda ya badawa pH dacewa. Hakan, **Option C** yana nuna cewa **kalkulus na excess moles** yana iya nuna kamar yadda pH yana badawa dacewa a lokaci haka. 

**Option A, B, D** yana da amfani da aikin ƙarfi (pH indicator, software), kamar yadda ake nuna pH, kawai **Option C** yana nuna **sababu kimyawa** don pH badawa dacewa (buffer capacity ya kusanta, excess moles ya badawa pH).

Aikin koyoyin malami da aka bayyana (rubuta tsare-tsaren lantarki, zana Lewis structures, gano samfuran ƙwayoyin biyu da ashirin, da kamanceceniya tsakanin siffofin ƙwayoyin guda biyu) yana da ƙungiyar **VSEPR (Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion)**. **Tallaci:**  
Tasirin Doppler yana da shi kuma yana canza **tsawon zango** (frequency) da **girman zango** (wavelength) a cikin abubuwan halitta, amma **gudun yaɗuwar sauti** (speed of sound) **ba yana canjawa** ba a cikin medium (kamar haka, a gari). Gudun yaɗuwar sauti yana da shi kuma yana dawwama tare da siffofin medium (kamar haka, kusancin gari, ƙarfi, da sauransu), amma **ba yana da shi kuma ga harbocin mai ji** (source) da **mai kalla** (observer). 

Wanne ɗalibi yana ce cewa gudun yaɗuwar sauti yana canjawa saboda harboci, wanne ce **kuskure**, domin yana dawwama. Tasirin Doppler yana faruwa ne kawai ga **tsawon zango** da **girman zango**, kamar haka:

- **Idan mai ji yana ƙaru**, tsawon zango zai **ragu** (increase), amma gudun yaɗuwar sauti **ba yana canjawa** ba.
- **Idan mai kalla yana ƙaru**, tsawon zango zai **kasa** (decrease), amma gudun yaɗuwar sauti **ba yana canjawa** ba.

**Option B** yana iya **sharar koyon ɗalibin** domin yana ce cewa gudun yaɗuwar sauti **ba yana canjawa** ba a Tasirin Doppler, amma **tsawon zango** yana canza saboda canji na mai ji da mai kalla. Wanne ce **kafin talla**, domin yana iya **sharar martani** da **koyon ɗalibin** da yake ga canji na gudun yaɗuwar sauti. 

**Option A, C, da D** yana iya **kafin kuskure**, domin yana ce cewa gudun yaɗuwar sauti yana canjawa, wanne ce **kuskure** domin yana dawwama.

**Sahulci:**  
- **Kimiyya na Tambaya:** Tambayoyin D yana nuna ƙarfafan (kamar Fe, Cu, Mn) da suka iya samar da oxide daban-daban tare da oxidation state daban-daban (kamar Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺, Cu⁺/Cu²⁺).  
- **Ƙarfi na Ɗalibai:** Ɗaliban zai iya iya farko kowace oxidation state na karafe a cikin oxide (kamar FeO → Fe²⁺, Fe₂O₃ → Fe³⁺), kuma zai iya farko cewa karafan da suka iya samar da oxidation state daban-daban (kamar Fe, Cu) ya sa oxide daban-daban.  
- **Ƙarfi na Tsarin Stock:** Tambayoyin D yana nuna ƙarfi na tsarin Stock domin sanya sunan oxide (kamar Iron(II) oxide vs. Iron(III) oxide), kuma zai iya iya farko cewa Roman numerals yana nuna oxidation state na karafe.

Biyan **B** ("Lushin burodi da aka yi da yisti") ce misali mai kyau don nuna dangantaka tsakanin **zafi da girman gas** (pressure da temperature). Wanne yana nuna cewa sun iya fahimta kamata bambancin mita (frequency) saboda gudun mai fitarwa (source) ko mai karɓa (observer) don ruwa, wanda yana da ƙungiyar Doppler.

**Kamar yadda kungiyar Doppler yana nuna**, bambancin mita ya kamata idan mai karɓa (observer) ko mai fitarwa (source) yana gudu don ruwa. **Ayyukan D** yana nuna cewa sun iya fahimta **wace kamata ce** (why it changes), wanda yana da ƙungiyar **tasirin Doppler**.

**Bayan:**  
Ƙa'idar Bernoulli yana da hubu kuma da ƙa'idar karewar makamashi (conservation of energy), kamar yake kafin koyi. Ƙa'idar Bernoulli yana nuna cewa kamar da suka dacewa na abubuwan ruwa (kamar birni), suka kamata da kusancin daidai (pressure) ya kamata. Wanne yana da hubu kuma da ƙa'idar karewar makamashi, kamar yake kafin koyi, kamar cewa kusancin daidai da suka kamata yana da hubu ga kusancin kinetik da suka kamata. 

**Kamar yake kafin koyi:**  
- **A (Pascal):** Yanayin Pascal yana da hubu ga kusancin daidai a cikin abubuwan ruwa, lekun yana da farko ga kusancin kinetik.  
- **C da D:** Yanayin da ke nuna amfani da ruwa daga cikin kusancin daidai, lekun yana da farko ga kusancin kinetik.  
- **B (Karewar Makamashi):** Ƙa'idar Bernoulli yana da hubu kuma da karewar makamashi, kamar yake kafin koyi, kamar cewa kusancin daidai da suka kamata yana da hubu ga kusancin kinetik. 

**Sahulwarsa:**
